assets.title: Venture Builders
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural / premium editorial cutout. Create ONE new bespoke photographic asset for an Atlas venture-capital website investment-pillar card. Square 1200x1200 with a TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. The photographed subject centered within the inner80%, fully in frame, generous transparent padding on all edges. No floor, room, sky, colored matte, checkerboard, surrounding scenery, typography, logo, border or frame. The subject is an impeccably isolated real photographed scene/object, professionally retouched with natural texture and clean edges. Extremely fine realistic material detail, clear silhouette at small card size. Restrained grayscale, warm silver, graphite and tiny muted lilac accents only. Elegant gallery-grade editorial photography, soft daylight plus defined gentle highlights, no surreal CGI, no cartoon, no fake film damage, no sparkles, no excessive depth blur. Asset intended to be composited on Malachite green #256C50. Do not fill any part of the transparent background.
SUBJECT: a tiny cohesive full-body candid group of three technical cofounders collaborating at one narrow freestanding transparent glass planning board. One woman late30s in a dark casual jacket points thoughtfully at a simple drawn product schematic, a man in a charcoal knit sweater listens, a second woman in light trousers holds a physical prototype. Show only the three people, the slim glass board with its two supports, the small prototype. Nobody poses for camera or smiles artificially. Naturally asymmetrical faces, normal skin pores, human proportions, correctly formed hands and fingers. Board diagrams are faint geometric pencil marks with NO readable writing. Documentary monochrome, subtle film-like tonal quality but no grain at alpha edges. The scene represents builders testing an idea together. It should feel photographic and serious, neither corporate stock teamwork nor a dollhouse. Preserve full legs and shoes.
